nodes.label: Dev Postgres service (idle-factory-dev on 5433)
nodes.rationale: postgres:16-alpine with user/password idle and DB idle-factory-dev, published on host port 5433 to avoid clashing with a local system Postgres on 5432. pg_isready healthcheck gates dependents.

nodes.label: Dev Redis service (port 6380)
nodes.rationale: redis:7-alpine published on 6380 (not 6379) for the same host-port-collision reason as Postgres; backs the optional REDIS_URL path of DatabaseClient.
